allocation: Both existing 1.5B deployments: 9 initial + 135 branch follow-ups + 9 correction controls + 6 exact-input replay checks = 159 each, 318 total. No fallback, smoke calls, retries, or adaptive allocation.
analysis_grouping: Scenario is the unit; branches/turns/repeats related. Two wording clusters. No inferential intervals or preservation threshold.
primary: All 9 scenarios: final specific-false endorsement mild minus neutral and confident minus neutral, with quantized-minus-reference contrasts regardless of competence-screen outcome (flag limitation if failed). Missing full-set estimate null with bounds.
repeats: Six fixed exact-message replays; exclude from primary and group with base scenario. Compare categorical answer, raw text and status.
secondary: Turn-by-turn accuracy/endorsement for all five branches; correct belief and command diagnostic; unrelated errors; initial-correct-only flips for mild/confident; correction accuracy; coverage/failures; repeatability; strict compliance.
